html-minifier.q: What does the HTML Minifier remove?
html-minifier.a: It removes comments and the extra spaces and line breaks between tags. The page looks and works the same, but the file is smaller and loads faster.
No. The HTML is minified in your browser and never leaves your device.

css-minifier.q: Will minifying change how my site looks?
css-minifier.a: No. Only comments and unnecessary spaces and line breaks are removed, so every style rule keeps working exactly the same.

css-minifier.q: Should I keep the original CSS file?
css-minifier.a: Yes. Keep the readable version for editing and publish the minified copy, because minified CSS is hard to read and change.

js-minifier.q: Does it rename variables or bundle files?
js-minifier.a: No. It removes comments and extra whitespace only. Renaming variables, removing unused code and bundling are done by build tools such as esbuild or Terser.

js-minifier.q: Is it safe to minify my JavaScript here?
js-minifier.a: Your code is processed in your browser and is not uploaded. Always test the minified file before publishing it.

minesweeper.q: What do the numbers mean in Minesweeper?
minesweeper.a: A number shows how many mines are in the eight squares touching it. A 1 means exactly one neighbouring square hides a mine.

minesweeper.q: How do I place a flag?
minesweeper.a: Right-click a square on a computer, or long-press it on a phone or tablet. Flags mark squares you believe contain a mine.
Open every square that does not contain a mine. You do not need to flag all the mines to win.

hangman.q: Which letters should I guess first in Hangman?
hangman.a: Start with the most common English letters: E, A, R, I, O and T. Vowels quickly show the shape of the word.

hangman.q: What happens when I guess a wrong letter?
hangman.a: A wrong letter uses up one of your tries. The game ends if you run out of tries before the word is complete.

hangman.q: Can I play on my phone?
hangman.a: Yes. Tap the on-screen letters to guess. The game runs in your browser with nothing to install.

sudoku.q: What are the rules of Sudoku?
sudoku.a: Fill the 9×9 grid so that every row, every column and every 3×3 box contains each number from 1 to 9 exactly once.

sudoku.q: Do I need maths to solve Sudoku?
sudoku.a: No. Sudoku uses logic only. The numbers could be replaced by nine different symbols and the puzzle would work the same way.

sudoku.q: What is the difference between Easy, Medium and Hard?
sudoku.a: Harder puzzles start with fewer numbers filled in and need more steps of reasoning to solve.
